experiment.name: load_test_latency
experiment.description:
Production-grade HTTP Gateway Service Benchmark: Uvicorn ASGI behind NGINX Reverse Proxy over local loopback interface (127.0.0.1:8080 -> 127.0.0.1:8000). Evaluates:
  1. Open-loop constant-arrival-rate load testing (k6) sweeping offered load up to ~1.2x closed-loop capacity
     (500..5000 req/s) with 5x repetitions and randomized order, with automatic knee detection.
  2. Open-loop testing for the BLENDED stream at measured empirical ER (37.7%) and HOLD vs ASYNC below saturation.
  3. Per-stage micro-profiling (parse, features, predict, enqueue) without reused timing arrays, plus ONNX-vs-sklearn parity and ablation.
  4. Escalation modes under realistic mixed stream: timeout rates, fail-open forwarded unverified, fail-closed 504, and ASYNC exposure window.
  5. Blended validation: linear mean validation in closed-loop, empirical mixture quantile validation in open-loop.
  6. System telemetry recording memory pressure and swap usage (zero isolated cores claims).
  7. Empirical ER reported separately for benign-only and attack-only held-out traffic.
